full_translation_en: Nepal Parliament, Federal Parliament, House of Representatives Notice-9. Nepal Parliament. Date: 2083 Ashad 30, Tuesday. Meeting scheduled to convene at 11:00 AM. Due to unavoidable reasons, the meeting of the House of Representatives scheduled for Wednesday, Ashad 31, 2083, at 11:00 AM, could not be held. Therefore, as per Rule 6(3) of the House of Representatives Procedures, 2083, the Speaker has rescheduled the meeting to convene at 9:00 AM on the same day. This notice is published for the information of all Honourable Members. Signed, Prasad Pandey, Secretary-General.

sections.name: Notice of Rescheduled Meeting
sections.summary_en: This notice informs the Honourable Members of the House of Representatives that the meeting scheduled for Ashad 31, 2083, at 11:00 AM has been postponed due to unavoidable reasons. The Speaker has rescheduled the meeting to 9:00 AM on the same day, Ashad 31, 2083, in accordance with Rule 6(3) of the House of Representatives Procedures.
